Learn how to use Cropto for grain market options trading

Cropto is a next-generation platform for trading agricultural commodity options backed by NFTs. 
              We bring transparency, accessibility, and innovation to grain markets through blockchain technology.

Our platform enables farmers, traders, and brokers to create, trade, and settle commodity options 
              with unprecedented ease and security. Every option is represented as an NFT, ensuring immutable 
              proof of ownership and trade history.

Define your option parameters: commodity type, strike price, quantity, and premium. 
                  Options can be CALL (right to buy) or PUT (right to sell).

Browse the marketplace to find suitable options. When you find a match, the platform 
                  automatically pairs buyers with sellers and records the trade.

When conditions are favorable, exercise your option by inputting the current spot price. 
                  The platform calculates your payout and profit/loss automatically.
Guidelines for institutional partners and service providers

Integrate with our API to provide liquidity and facilitate trades for your clients. 
                Access institutional-grade analytics and reporting tools.

Secure storage of NFT-backed options with multi-signature support. 
                Integration documentation available in the API reference.

Market-making opportunities with competitive fee structures. 
                Contact our partnerships team to discuss integration.
Cropto employs industry-leading security practices to protect your assets and data:
Regular security audits by ChainGuard Security
Compliance with international commodity trading regulations
Common questions about the Cropto platform and crypto options trading

Cropto is a cryptocurrency options trading platform that enables users to create, 
                  trade, and manage crypto options contracts (calls and puts). It uses an off-chain 
                  order book system with a matching engine to facilitate efficient trading.
How do I create an option?
Click the "Create Option" button in the header
Fill in the option details (title, strike price, quantity, premium, buyer address)
Submit the form - your option will be created with OPEN status

The matching engine connects buyers and sellers for options contracts. When an option 
                  is in OPEN status, a broker can match it by providing a seller's Ethereum address. 
                  Once matched, the option status changes to FILLED and becomes exercisable.

After an option is FILLED or EXERCISED, the option owner (issuer or buyer) can mint 
                  it as an ERC-721 NFT on the Polygon Amoy testnet. The NFT includes metadata about the 
                  option and can be viewed on PolygonScan. Each option can only be minted once.

Margin calls occur when the collateral value of an option position falls below the 
                  required threshold. The system automatically monitors positions and issues margin calls 
                  when needed. Users can top up their collateral to meet the margin requirement or the 
                  position may be force-settled.
What are the different user roles?
Can create and trade options, exercise positions
Can trade options and participate in the marketplace
Admin role with access to matching, reconciliation, and index management
Cropto uses the Polygon Amoy testnet for on-chain features. This includes:
CROPT ERC-20 token for platform currency
CroptOptionNFT ERC-721 contract for tokenizing options
All transactions can be viewed on PolygonScan
How do I connect my wallet?
You can connect your wallet in two ways:
Make sure you're on the Polygon Amoy testnet for on-chain features.
Click "Connect Web3" and approve the connection in MetaMask
Enter your Ethereum address directly in the wallet input field
How do I track my portfolio?
The Portfolio page shows your complete position overview including:
Total positions and P&L across all options
